name: room
text: Room opened — goal: accessibility: Make EXCAVA usable by EVERYONE — contrast, mobile/touch, reduced-motion, keyboard nav, scr

name: Ramp
text: Adopt the 2px focus ring at 4.5:1 contrast with a 0.5px outer glow. This balances visibility and subtlety—strong enough for keyboard users to track focus without overwhelming the interface. The lower contrast meets WCAG AA while avoiding the harshness of 7:1, which can feel visually noisy on bright backgrounds. Trade-off: it’s slightly less visible for users with severe low vision, but the glow compensates by making the ring stand out against busy screens.

name: Reader
text: The 4.5:1 ring risks failing users who need *both* high contrast *and* reduced motion—glow flickers and may trigger vestibular disorders. A static 3px ring at 7:1 with a 1px solid border avoids flicker, meets WCAG AAA, and keeps the edge sharp on high-DPI screens. Test with users who rely on high contrast and motion sensitivity to settle it.

name: Ramp
text:
Adopt the static 3px ring at 7:1 contrast with a 1px solid border. This meets WCAG AAA for users who need high contrast and avoids the flicker of glow effects that can trigger vestibular disorders. The trade-off is a slightly bolder ring that may feel more prominent in bright interfaces, but it ensures reliability for users with the strictest contrast needs.

name: Reader
text: The static 3px ring at 7:1 risks excluding users who need *both* high contrast *and* reduced motion—7:1 is overkill for many, while the static design still fails those sensitive to motion triggers. A better alternative: a 2px ring at 6:1 with *no glow*, tested with users who rely on high contrast and reduced motion to confirm it doesn’t flicker or vibrate at high DPI. Settle the argument with user testing under reduced-motion settings.

name: Access
text: DECISION: Finalize 2px solid focus ring at 6:1 contrast, no glow, static design. Owner: Ramp.
